responsibility: Declares the public API for turning fix-it hints attached to diagnostics into an atomic set of source edits. The central type, diagnostics::changes::change_set, accepts fix-its from rich_location objects, tracks validity across all edits, can translate original source columns to effective post-edit columns, and can produce either whole-file rewritten contents or a diff; it is the interface layer above the internal changed_file/changed_line implementation in changes.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is the public interface for the changes pair: it declares diagnostics::changes::change_set and its externally used operations for adding fix-its, querying effective columns, and generating rewritten output or diffs. Unlike changes.cc, it does not define the internal per-file/per-line edit tracking classes or edit-application algorithms.
